replacements.suggestedLessonTitle: Bring selected clips into your first timeline
replacements.creator: Justin Brown · Primal Video
replacements.timingEvidence: Creator's official YouTube description places importing at 01:50 and the next editing chapter at 03:40.
replacements.purpose: Import chosen footage and locate the timeline before making the first three-shot assembly.
replacements.fitLimit: 2021 interface. The exact three-shot exercise is Framepath's application, not a claimed creator assignment. Use an editor already available to the learner.
replacements.note: Creator's VN importing chapter, recorded in 2021. Controls may differ in your version; the same selection and timeline decisions work in an editor you already use.
replacements.reading: Choose three clips that show context, action and result. Make a new editing project and add only those clips. Find the timeline and play the rough sequence once. At this stage, keep the task small: a clear beginning, middle and ending are enough.

replacements.title: How to Edit Video on iPhone (COMPLETE Beginner's Guide for 2025)
replacements.suggestedLessonTitle: Trim clips for a clearer sequence
replacements.creator: Justin Brown · Primal Video
replacements.timingEvidence: Creator's official YouTube description starts the trimming/cutting chapter at 04:23 and the reordering chapter at 06:58.
replacements.purpose: Trim the start/end of a take, split around unwanted material and remove pauses or mistakes so the sequence is clearer.
replacements.fitLimit: VN on iPhone in 2025. Android controls can differ. Framepath should connect each trim to clarity and pacing rather than teach the controls alone.
replacements.primaryCompanionEvidence: The creator's guide explicitly names VN, explains trimming with clip handles or the split tool, and says the workflow transfers to another editor. The guide is an AI-assisted summary, not a verbatim transcript.
replacements.note: Creator's trimming chapter in VN on iPhone, recorded in 2025. Apply the same remove–play–check decisions in your phone editor; controls may differ.
replacements.reading: Play a clip and find when its useful action begins. Trim the waiting before it and after the action finishes. Split around an unwanted pause or mistake when needed. Play across the join and check that the action still makes sense. Compare a shorter and longer version before choosing the pace.
